title: CSI HPR — Horizontal Position Relative
summary: CSI Pn a moves the cursor right Pn columns (default 1). Equivalent to CUF but does not stop at the right margin (may wrap or be ignored depending on terminal).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: the CSI sequence ends at its final byte.

params.name: HPR (Horizontal Position Relative)
params.meaning: CSI Pn a moves the cursor right Pn columns.

gotchas: HPR and CUF ('C') are similar; CUF is more widely supported.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: CSI sequence renders as a byte-exact sequence with final byte 'a'.
